inputs.name: hand over from Feature Store to Training Pipeline

output.level_0: Training crashes nightly because feature values are null, and no one knows why.
output.level_1: The team copies raw till data into notebooks, skipping the feature store entirely.
output.level_2: Engineers manually export feature tables and paste them into the training script each week.
output.level_3: The pipeline pulls versioned features from the store automatically before every retraining run.
output.level_4: Access to loyalty features is logged, and training only starts after consent checks pass.
